summary: A 19-year-old Tennessee man backpacking about 3.5 miles up the East Inlet Trail was scrambling over steep boulders and downed trees when a large boulder fell onto his leg; companions freed him and called for help. A 15-member park SAR team reached him around 11:30 p.m., stayed with him overnight providing advanced care, and he was hoisted out by helicopter the next day to Harbison Meadow, then taken to Middle Park Medical Center.
location: East Inlet Trail, ~3.5 mi from trailhead
responding_agency: RMNP SAR; Grand County EMS; Grand Lake Fire Protection District; Grand County Sheriff's Office; Grand County SAR
notes: NPS morning-report compendium entry (npshistory.com romo.htm), parent-opened and verified at run 580.
